facts.text: Machine learning (ML) is software whose behavior is learned from examples rather than written as explicit rules.
facts.quote: Machine learning (ML) is software whose behavior is learned from examples rather than written as explicit rules

facts.text: A machine-learning neural network's learned behavior cannot be fully specified by requirements.
facts.quote: No requirement can fully specify what it has learned

facts.text: Machine-learning software may fail on inputs unlike its training data, including a new site, season or clothing.
facts.quote: it may fail on inputs unlike its training data (a new site, season or clothing)

facts.text: Machine-learning confidence scores may not match actual accuracy.
facts.quote: its confidence scores may not match its real accuracy

facts.text: Retraining machine-learning software changes its behavior in ways that are hard to bound.
facts.quote: retraining changes its behavior in ways that are hard to bound

facts.text: Ordinary code review and requirements-based coverage do not apply directly to machine-learning software.
facts.quote: ordinary code review and requirements-based coverage do not apply to it directly

facts.text: The EU Machinery Regulation applies from 20 January 2027 and lists safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions among products requiring a notified body.
facts.quote: The EU Machinery Regulation, applying from 20 January 2027, lists "safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions" among products that need a notified body

facts.text: Whether a frozen, non-learning machine-learning model falls within the EU Machinery Regulation's notified-body provision for self-evolving safety components is disputed and unsettled.
facts.quote: whether a frozen, non-learning model counts is disputed and unsettled

facts.text: The amended AI Act moves obligations for high-risk AI embedded in machinery to 2 August 2028.
facts.quote: The amended AI Act moves obligations for high-risk AI embedded in machinery to 2 August 2028

facts.text: ISO/IEC TR 5469:2024 provides guidance rather than requirements.
facts.quote: ISO/IEC TR 5469:2024 is guidance, not requirements

facts.text: ISO/PAS 8800:2024 tailors ISO 26262 for AI in road vehicles only.
facts.quote: ISO/PAS 8800:2024 tailors ISO 26262 for AI in road vehicles only

facts.text: The booklet found no off-road standard with machine-learning clauses.
facts.quote: no off-road standard with machine-learning clauses was found

facts.text: In the absence of an off-road standard with machine-learning clauses, training-set coverage, distribution shift, retraining, non-determinism, confidence calibration and change control must be treated as additional safety-case subjects.
facts.quote: so training-set coverage, distribution shift, retraining, non-determinism, confidence calibration and change control must be treated as additional safety-case subjects

facts.text: Validation data for machine learning must be real or physically independent of whatever generated the training data.
facts.quote: Validation data must be real or physically independent of whatever generated the training data

facts.text: Synthetic images augment real images for machine learning; synthetic images do not replace real images.
facts.quote: synthetic images augment real ones, they do not replace them

facts.text: Experts disagree on machine learning in safety functions: one view excludes ML and uses certified deterministic sensors, while the other accepts ML under ISO/PAS 8800-style assurance.
facts.quote: Experts disagree: one view keeps ML out of the safety function and uses certified deterministic sensors; the other accepts ML under ISO/PAS 8800-style assurance

facts.text: A non-ML safety channel, such as radar-only braking with ML used only for warnings, could change the regulatory route.
facts.quote: A non-ML safety channel, for example radar-only braking with ML used only for warnings, could change the regulatory route

facts.text: For a product sold in the EU after 20 January 2027 whose safety function uses machine learning, the booklet advises planning for notified-body involvement unless legal advice concludes otherwise.
facts.quote: If machine learning performs the safety function in a product sold in the EU after 20 January 2027, the booklet advises planning for notified-body involvement unless legal advice concludes otherwise

facts.text: The architecture choice for machine learning in safety functions shapes the whole evidence plan and should be made early.
facts.quote: The architecture choice shapes the whole evidence plan and should be made early.
